description: A work experience entry in the user's professional profile.

main.description: Record representing a single work position or role.

company.description: Company or organization name. Optional: omit for self-employed, freelance, contract, or independent work that has no separately named or registered entity.

companyDid.description: DID of the company's ATproto account, if one exists. Enables verified company linking.

entityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the organization the user selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q...), a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Enables deterministic resolution to a canonical entity even before the org claims an ATproto account. Absent for free-text or independent/self-employed positions.

agentRef.description: The employer, as a single nested reference mirroring the flat company / companyDid / entityRef fields. Additive dual-write: the flat fields remain the source of truth for existing consumers.

description.description: Description of responsibilities, achievements, and duties.

employmentType.description: Type of employment (full-time, part-time, contract, etc.).
employmentType.x-skos:note: schema:employmentType is free text. ESCO is the better value anchor.

onBehalfOf.description: Name of the party this role is held on behalf of, when the person represents someone else — most often a fund whose board seat this is. A disclosure, not a role type. Omit for independent seats.

onBehalfOfDid.description: DID of the represented party's ATproto account, if one exists. May resolve to an organization or to a person (e.g. a family-office principal).

onBehalfOfEntityRef.description: Portable, app-neutral identifier for the represented party selected from a resolver dropdown: a Wikidata Q-ID URI, a ROR URI, or an LEI URI. Absent for free-text entries.

workplaceType.x-skos:note: schema.org models only a remote flag; Sifa distinguishes onSite, remote, and hybrid.

location.description: Work location. Sifa enforces ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes at the app layer.

startedAt.description: Start date of the position in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format.

endedAt.description: End date of the position in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit if this is a current position.

skills.description: Skills used in this position. Each entry is a URI reference to an id.sifa.profile.skill record owned by the same DID.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the user's primary current position, displayed on the identity card.

labels.description: Self-label values for this position record.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when this record was originally created.
